query: I have a 48-year-old female patient to evaluate. Among female Medicare patients aged 43–53 admitted from the emergency department with a principal diagnosis of bowel obstruction, how many completed index admissions were identified in this cohort in the dataset?
final_sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS num_completed_index_admissions
FROM 
  `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
INNER JOIN 
  `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id
INNER JOIN 
  `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
  ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id 
  AND a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
WHERE 
  p.gender = 'F'
  AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 43 AND 53
  AND a.insurance = 'Medicare'
  AND a.admission_location = 'EMERGENCY ROOM'
  AND d.seq_num = 1
  AND (
    (d.icd_version = 9 AND d.icd_code = '5609') 
    OR 
    (d.icd_version = 10 AND d.icd_code LIKE 'K56.6%')
  )
  AND a.dischtime IS NOT NULL;
